About this Event

Mid Michigan Bridal Expo - Ann ArborGet ready for the ultimate bridal experience at the Mid Michigan Bridal Expo in Ann Arbor! This in-person event is your perfect chance to meet top vendors, discover stunning gowns, and gather inspiration for your big day. Whether you're newly engaged or deep into planning, you’ll find everything you need under one roof. Don't miss out on a fun day filled with ideas, samples, and plenty of bridal excitement!
